Loop through a dictionary in three ways.

Supplied answer
student = {"name": "Surya", "age": 23, "course": "MCA"}
for key in student: # keys only
    print(key, "->", student[key])
for value in student.values(): # values only
    print(value)
for key, value in student.items(): # both together (best)
    print(key, ":", value)
Note: items() gives key and value in one step - the cleanest way.
